contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy Roman brooch of the Continental plate type, dating to AD 80-250. It has a lozenge-shaped plate, with a moulded foot protruding from its lower corner; the moulding of the foot consists of an upper waist, which is followed by a transverse rounded ridge between two raised lines. The back face of the foot has an incomplete triangular catch-plate. The front face of the plate…
